caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn carriage with two large, pale-colored horses in motion, facing to the left. The horses are outfitted with red harnesses and are attached to the front of the vehicle, pulling it forward. The carriage itself consists of a long, slender structure painted in pale blue and black, with a large red bucket hanging underneath the body. There are two large spoked wheels at the rear of the carriage and two smaller wheels under the front section attached to the horses. Seated atop a red seat near the front of the carriage is a person wearing dark clothing and a pointed hat. The background is plain, with the entire arrangement rendered against an off-white or beige canvas. The drawing uses mostly muted colors, with highlights in red, blue, and black for the main features.
title: Toy Hook and Ladder, with Two Horses
